D. 2645.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. I. S. B. REGISTER
3865
21/7/32

July 21, 2.

Sir,

I am in receipt of your letter of
June 29, 1932, concerning B.M. Donaldson and
have to forward the following particulars of this
man's career whilst he was in Shanghai, where he
was known as Benjamin Morris Donaldson.

He arrived in Shanghai from Canada by
the President Madison on March 6, 1930.

He obtained a position as salesman with
the American Engineering Coy on 20-4-30 staying
with this firm until 31-7-30, then joining Anderson
Meyer Company as salesman on 1-8-30 and leaving them
on 31-10-30.

From 1-11-30 to 6-12-30 he was unemployed.
On 7-12-30 he was employed by the Office
Appliance Company, leaving them on 8-4-31.

From 9-4-31 to 25-5-31 he was out of
employment, and on 26-5-31 obtained a post with
Commercial Press until 10-6-31. From 17-6-31 to
13-7-31 he was employed by Millingtons Ltd..

During his stay in Shanghai he resided at
the Cathay Hotel, the American Club and finally the
Savoy Hotel.
page_data.zh:
D. 2645.
上海公共租界
刑事调查特别股登记册
3865
1932年7月21日

1932年7月21日。

先生，

我已收到您1932年6月29日关于 B.M. Donaldson 的来信，现呈报该人在上海期间（当时名为 Benjamin Morris Donaldson）的履历详情如下。

他于1930年3月6日乘“麦迪逊总统号” (President Madison) 从加拿大抵达上海。

他于1930年4月20日在美国工程公司 (American Engineering Coy) 获得销售员职位，在该公司工作至1930年7月31日，随后于1930年8月1日加入安德森·迈耶公司 (Anderson Meyer Company) 担任销售员，并于1930年10月31日离职。

从1930年11月1日至1930年12月6日，他处于失业状态。1930年12月7日，他受雇于办公用具公司 (Office Appliance Company)，并于1931年4月8日离职。

从1931年4月9日至1931年5月25日，他再次失业，并于1931年5月26日在商务印书馆 (Commercial Press) 获得职位，工作至1931年6月10日。从1931年6月17日至1931年7月13日，他受雇于 Millingtons Ltd. 公司。

在上海逗留期间，他先后居住在华懋饭店 (Cathay Hotel)、美国总会 (American Club)，最后入住萨伏伊饭店 (Savoy Hotel)。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Various thefts of money over a period of
several months were reported to the Police by
residents of the Y.M.C.A. and on 13-7-1931 Donaldson
was arrested by detectives attached to Sinsza Station
for committing these larcenies.

He was charged before H.B.M. Court and whilst
on remand made a statement admitting stealing various
sums aggregating $138.00 over a period of 6 months
from residents of the Y.M.C.A..

He was on remand until 25-7-31 when the
following judgment was given:-

(1) He goes on board the S.S. Oakworth today
and remains there until the ship sails.
(2) He returns to Canada.
(3) He does not return to Shanghai.

Donaldson was handed over to the Master of
the S.S. Oakworth by the Police and signed on as a
Supernumerary Cabin boy.

During the period of his stay in Shanghai the
Police have no information that he was connected with
any communistic or other political activities.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

J.H. McMillan Esquire,
Commissioner of Pol. Police,
Victoria, B.C..
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

青年会 (Y.M.C.A.) 住户向警方报告了数月内发生的多起现金盗窃案，1931年7月13日，Donaldson 因犯下这些盗窃罪被新闸捕房 (Sinsza Station) 的侦探逮捕。

他在英国陛下法院 (H.B.M. Court) 被起诉，并在还押候审期间作出供认，承认在6个月内从青年会住户处窃取总计138.00美元的多笔款项。

他还押候审至1931年7月25日，当日判决如下：

(1) 他须于今日登上“奥克沃斯号”轮船 (S.S. Oakworth)，并留在船上直至该船启航。
(2) 他返回加拿大。
(3) 他不得返回上海。

警方将 Donaldson 移交给“奥克沃斯号”轮船船长，他以额外客舱服务生 (Supernumerary Cabin boy) 的身份签约上船。

在他上海逗留期间，警方未掌握其与共产主义或其他任何政治活动有关的线索。

先生，
您忠实的仆人，

(签名) K. M. Bourne.
副总监（罪案）。

J.H. McMillan 先生，
警察总监，
不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市。

The Deputy Commissioner,
Crime Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai, China.

Dear Sir:

I have been asked to obtain particulars
regarding a man named B. M. Donaldson. I under-
stand this man was deported from China some time
in 1931 and I would be glad if you would let me
know what his record is, criminal or otherwise.

Any information you can let me have will
be very much appreciated.

Yours truly,

J.H.McMullin,
Commissioner,
B. C. Police.
